name: say-hi
description: Installs say-hi inside the container and wires the remote user's shell to it, so a devcontainer or Codespaces terminal is styled with no client involved.

version.description: Which say-hi to install: 'latest' for the newest release, a release version such as '1.0.0', or 'main' for the current branch (unverified - no SHA256SUMS exists for a branch).

preset.description: The feature preset hi --configure writes for the remote user. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md's Presets.

configureShell.description: Run 'hi --install' for the remote user, adding say-hi's lines to their shell rc files. With this off the tree is installed and /usr/bin/hi works, but the terminal is not styled.
